en: The girl who's doing that concert⑬Haruka Sawamura⑬she's under my care.
What!? Are you serious!?
And unfortunately, both she and I are committed to her performing. No matter what.
She's actually been continuing her lessons in private with folks from her agency.
And I already turned down someone else's offer to stop the concert. And let me tell you, that guy was willing to pay a lot!
But we have no idea how dangerous this might be!
I realize the risk, but I won't give up on the show so easily.
A lot of people's dreams are riding on it.
Dreams, huh?
That said, if we hold the event anyway, there's no guarantee the audience will be safe.
We've got to do all we can to eliminate any threats. I agree with you on that front.
If you agreed you'd cancel the event.
I can't do that.
If I did, Haruka-chan's dream would be dead⑬a dream that Park-san sacrificed so much for.
You have to seize your dreams when you can. There might not be a second chance.
Just like that home run of yours.
Haruka-chan will live her dream. And I'll make sure she won't be in danger.
How will you do that?
The first step is... we have to find out what they've got planned.
How are we going to do that? We don't have any leads on the Kuroha Family.
True. But Katsuya said he'd already talked with the event organizers about canceling.
There's no way he did that without using a ton of money, or maybe violence, to put on the pressure.
How else could you nix an event at a venue like the Japan Dome? And just two days in advance?
Unless the organizer was already in cahoots with Katsuya.
Fun thought, eh? All right then, let's go play detective with Katsuya!
Now? Fine, no time like the present. So we just show up there? Do you even know where he's at?
His company is MAO, Inc. As for its location...
No one knows where they are. Not even Yamaura-san, and she runs Dyna Chair now!
How does that happen?
The company can be reached, but no matter what you ask, they say you have to talk to the president.
And when you ask where the president is, they say they don't know.
That's ridiculous.
Yeah, but there's not much we can do about it. And hey, we don't have time for normal avenues like that anyway.
What's our move, then? We have to find out where that president is.
Yep, and we should ask the people who know this town better than anyone.
Who?
The homeless. I've got connections with them. I used to be homeless myself, years ago.
Huh. Interesting circle of friends you got.
You bet. Let's see who we can find.
Sorry for the wait. Wanna get going?
Akiyama-san! You sure took your time.
Sorry about that. Let's go.
Fucking hell...
Let's go before the cops show up. That was a hell of a brawl.
True that!
Hmm. This look like the place?
Uh, who might you guys be?
None of your fucking business. Now go on, get that pretty little face outta here.
Well, that tells us all we need to know. We're not going anywhere, so step aside.
Heh, guess you bastards got a death wish. All right, let's get 'em!
Ah, this might be it.
That you, Akiyama? It's me.
Thanks for getting in touch. You learn anything?
Yeah. You know the MEB info booth over on Shichifuku? You want the top floor of the building next door.
Great work! How'd you find the place?
Oh, the guys know the place. It's where some of the best food gets thrown out!
No kidding? Thanks. You've been a big help.
Sure thing. See you around.
Man... Now that's street smarts.
Yep. Now let's get our butts over to Shichifuku.
Ah, this could be it.
We'd better bring a little gift with us.
Let's go buy some liquor. A whole lot of it.
...Sure.
(Boy, we're really up against it here... Time to head back to <Color:7>Sky Finance<Color:Default> and come up with a plan.)
I don't know anything! Not a damn thing!
I haven't even started asking questions yet. So you're obviously hiding something big. Real big.
No way! I'm just doing what Ka-chan told me!
He said a moneylender like you would show up. I'm supposed to give you the brush-off!
Ka-chan... You mean Katsuya?
Yeah! The president of Osaka Talent! Who else?
How did Katsuya know that I would come here?
How should I know? All he told me was you'd come wanting to know about that concert happening in two days.
I was supposed to stop you, if I could.
That explains why the building was crawling with guards from Ousaka Enterprises.
Hey, were you trying to run off with the 300 million yen that Park-san paid you?
No! For your information, I was about to take it to Osaka to give it back!
Plus, I wanted to visit her grave, which I haven't had time for yet.
Oh, sure. You wanna visit her, even though you broke your contract with her, and tried to switch to Katsuya.
That's not what happened! Not even close!
Ka-chan told me he'd already cleared my transfer with her. I'm no contract-breaker.
What a load of crap. How did she give her okay when she was dead?
You're lying through your teeth.
I'm not lying! Maybe I was a fool to believe what Ka-chan said.
But he did say it! He and Park-san had each other's back for over twenty years, you know.
I mean, he would be the last person to ever betray her! I'm sure of that.
Wait, back it up.
Katsuya and Park-san knew each other?
Yeah. I myself used to be Ka-chan's manager.
I knew them both back when they were starving artists trying to break into show business.
They both left the stage and ended up working behind the scenes.
And they've been close friends ever since.
Proof that I'm not lying. It's a photo of them from twenty years ago. The guy behind them was Park-san's boyfriend at the time.
I think his name was, um, something like⑬ Oh, it was Majima!
Not long after that photo was taken, Ka-chan hurt himself badly doing a stunt.
He was forced to retire. Luckily, Park-san and that Majima guy helped him recover and find a new job.
Majima-san helped?
Yeah. Enormously! See, going into management was the only way Ka-chan could stay in the business.
And competition was too fierce in Tokyo. It was impossible for him to set up a new agency here.
So he went to Osaka, where there was still room for growth. All he needed was an in with the local yakuza there.
Majima was the one who worked all of that out. And Osaka Talent was born!
Majima and Park-san parted ways soon after, though.
She ended up going to Osaka too, and establishing her own agency.
For both her and Ka-chan, it was living a piece of the dream.
Sure, they weren't stars, but it was the next best thing. And they worked together to achieve it.
I thought Dyna Chair and Osaka Talent were on bad terms.
Haha, that's all fake.
Pretending to be bitter rivals is a great way to generate buzz and publicity, especially in this industry.
Heck, there was a <Italic>ton</Italic> of coverage a few years ago when this hot two-girl act switched from Dyna Chair to Osaka Talent.
T-Set?
Ah, so you remember. Yeah, Park-san asked Ka-chan to take them on.
She said T-Set needed some strong competition to motivate them.
It was her idea to transfer them to Osaka Talent and make them grapple with the rest of Dyna Chair's up-and-comers.
Haha. It's just the sort of scheme she would come up with.
I'm just... surprised that Park-san, Katsuya, and Majima-san were all acquainted.
Small world, huh?
I guess Majima wasn't in touch with Park-san when she died.
But he's still in contact with Ka-chan!
I hear they still see each other every time they're both in Tokyo.
What!? So even now, Katsuya and Majima-san are...
Close friends, yeah. It's nice, don't you think?
I don't get it. That means Katsuya must have some other reason for canceling the concert.
Canceling!? I thought it was only postponed!
Why do you think that?
Well, because Ka-chan said he wanted it pushed back a day. Of course, I don't know what to believe from him anymore.
His reason seemed sound, though. He needed more time to work out choreography for a new song.
What on earth is he up to? It's all so weird...
Mind if I turn on the TV?
That's Katsuya.
I'm aware that T-Set seems to be making their debut on short notice.
Many of you have seen Haruka Sawamura-san from Dyna Chair on TV. She recently performed live in Kansai at the Princess League Finals.
Her debut concert was set to take place at the Japan Dome, but unfortunately, it seems she will no longer be able to perform.

As such, it's up to T-Set, her competitor in the finals,
to hold a concert in her place.
So this impromptu concert is really happening?
That is the plan.

After all, the members of T-Set already have the backing of
a leader in the music industry...

And since they've long been preparing for a major label
debut, I'd say they're more than ready to perform.
Osaka Talent sees this as a fortunate turn of events... though of course, we do feel badly for Haruka Sawamura-san.
There he is.
So that's Katsuya.
He's the one who killed Morinaga-aniki...
There's no proof of that yet. But according to leaks from the police investigation...
It's clear that they've identified him as a person of interest regarding Morinaga's death.
Where ya headed?
To see Katsuya, where else!?
He's staying at the hotel above us, isn't he? I'll beat the truth out of him!
In that state?
You? But why?
You're better off goin' to the police to get Morinaga's body taken care of.
Nothin' else you can do now.
Ain't he your sworn brother?
Go see him off.
What's our move, Kiryu-san?
No choice but to show up. He's sending us a message.
A message?

By appearing on TV, he's letting us know he's here,
poised to take over the Tojo Clan.
He's putting out the call to gather enemies and allies alike.
Where are you going, Kiryu-san!?
You stay here, Baba.
Huh? But...
There's something I want you to do for me.
I need you to go see Haruka Sawamura. She's holding a concert at the Japan Dome the day after tomorrow.
I'd like you to pass on a message for me.
Huh? Do you know her, Kiryu-san?
Yeah. It'd take a while to explain.
What's the message?
Tell her not to give up.
...Is that it?
Yeah. That's it.
You can change characters now.

Select "Select Character" from the hideout menu
to change who you control.

Kiryu can go to Nagasugai and Saejima can go to
Tsukimino by taxi. You cannot change characters
while in these cities.
(Katsuya is here. Am I ready to confront him?)
(Katsuya's here. Am I ready to go after him?)
(I should be better prepared.)
(Gotta get ready first.)
(This is it.)
(Let's go.)
How did you find me here?
I've been on your trail ever since Fukuoka, when I realized Aoyama betrayed me.
It took me a while to track you down.
So you've been suspecting me.

Yes. It all fell into place after our man, Azumi, and
Takachi from the Omi Alliance were killed in Nagoya.
It didn't make any sense. The Omi was trying to stop the Tojo Clan from forming alliances with regional groups.
But then, high-ranking members from both sides were killed in Nagoya.
The Nagoya Family, after being invisible for so long, suddenly sprang from the shadows.
I had to find out why.
So you were the one who got Shinada, that former baseball player, to look into the Nagoya Family?
Correct.
I needed to know who was controlling them.
I knew that would lead me to the one who orchestrated all this.
And everything pointed straight to you.
I see. When'd you first get a hunch it was me?
It was when you told me you were sick.

Your face was pale, and you looked weaker than you ever have
before. But your eyes told a different story.
They were the eyes of a man with a big task ahead of him. Not someone on the verge of death.
I guess the eyes don't lie, do they.
But if you had suspicions about me, why bother making alliances with those regional families?
You should have known that would end badly.
Well, I had problems of my own.
When an organization gets too big, it starts to fester. I saw this as a good time to lance the wound and clear out the infection.
I talked it over with Majima-san, and we decided to play along with your plan.
So you worked to purge the traitors that had wormed their way into the Tojo Clan.
Unlike you, I'm not just thinking about the short-term.
I have the future of the Tojo Clan in mind.
At some point I had to face the heads of the other yakuza groups across the country.
I learned a lot from them.
Okay, Chairman. Let's cut to the chase.
Once you and I fight it out, this all ends.
I don't know if you're really sick, but either way you're not long for this world, are you?
